system_definitions.selected_learned_retrieval: top K frozen learned-retriever chunks, restored to chronological order
system_definitions.clap_retrieval: top K frozen CLAP-prior chunks, restored to chronological order
system_definitions.deterministic_random_retrieval: K chunks with smallest SHA-256 rank of example ID and chunk index, restored to chronological order
system_definitions.uniform_retrieval: K unique rounded positions from an endpoint-inclusive uniform grid over the chunk stream
system_definitions.prefix_matched_retrieval: first K chunks of the composed stream
system_definitions.oracle_retrieval: up to K positive evidence chunks ranked by the frozen learned score, filled only when necessary by highest-scoring nonpositive chunks, restored to chronology
system_definitions.selected_retrieval_silenced: same indices and duration as selected learned retrieval with every waveform sample set to zero
system_definitions.text_only: identical frozen question prompt without an audio placeholder
